description: Returns wholesale electricity price benchmarks by ISO/RTO, compares data center developer portfolios, looks up organizations, tracks industry news, or screens critical equipment materials.

company.description: Company, developer, hyperscaler, or utility name, ticker, or organization ID (e.g. 'Microsoft', 'MSFT', 'QTS Data Centers', 'Dominion Energy').

company_name.description: Alias for company or organization name (e.g. 'Meta', 'QTS').

comparison_peer.description: Optional peer developer name for side-by-side comparison (e.g. 'Digital Realty').

days_back.description: Lookback window in days for market prices and news (default: 30).

developer_name.description: Developer or operator name to benchmark (e.g. 'QTS Data Centers', 'Vantage Data Centers').

iso_rto.description: Wholesale ISO/RTO region for electricity price benchmarks (e.g. 'PJM', 'ERCOT', 'NYISO').

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default: 10).

organization_name.description: Organization name to look up in the organization registry (e.g. 'Microsoft', 'Dominion Energy').

project.description: Project name, alias, canonical project ID, Map project ID, queue ID, or developer plus place (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Hyperion', 'AXP-US-LA-00003', 'QTS Atlanta').

query.description: Free-text query for market prices, developer benchmarking, or news (e.g. 'PJM hub prices').

name: benchmark_market_and_ecosystem

next_useful_tools.description: Suggested follow-up MCP tools relevant to this result.

status.description: Execution status (OK, SUCCESS, RESOLVED, AMBIGUOUS_ENTITY, NOT_FOUND, ERROR).

using_project.description: Banner confirming the resolved project name, city, state, and canonical ID when a project was matched.

title: Benchmark Power Market and Developers
